Notify.Unusable: Stagecraft: the stage description of "{scene}" cannot be drawn, so Foundry's own canvas is showing. See the console for why.
Notify.Failed: Stagecraft could not take over "{scene}", so Foundry's own canvas is showing. See the console.
Notify.TierNextScene: Stagecraft: the new picture quality applies from the next scene.
Notify.Flat: Stagecraft: this computer could not draw the 3D stage, so you are seeing the plain one. Everything still works.
Notify.FlatSoftware: Stagecraft: this computer draws graphics without a graphics card, so you are seeing the plain stage. Everything still works. You can change this in the module's settings.
Notify.SpeedLow: Stagecraft: this computer found the lit stage heavy, so it is drawing the lighter one now. Everything still works. You can change this in the module's settings (Stage picture quality).
Notify.SpeedFlat: Stagecraft: this computer found the 3D stage too heavy, so it is drawing the plain one now. Everything still works. You can change this in the module's settings (Stage picture quality).

Tier.Name: Stage picture quality
Tier.Hint: How much your computer draws on a stage scene. Automatic follows Foundry's own Performance Mode.
Tier.Flat: Flat: plain, for a weak computer

Zones.Name: Zone outlines at rest
Zones.Hint: How visible a zone's dashed outline is when nobody is holding a card near it. Carry a card near one and it lights up with its name and what it is for.
Zones.Off: Hidden until a card comes near

Power.Name: Save power when nothing moves
Power.Hint: Draws the stage 30 times a second while nothing on it is moving, and at full speed the moment anything does. It spares your computer's fan and battery over a long evening. Foundry's own Maximum Framerate setting is always obeyed.

Calm.Name: Calm mode
Calm.Hint: No flashes, sparks or film grain. Cards still move as you move them. Also on when Foundry's Photosensitive Mode or your system's reduced motion setting is.

Mode.Tip: Who may draw on this scene. Click to go round: as the scene says, off, in chalk zones only, anywhere.

Hands.Label: Hands off
Hands.Tip: Only a GM can move cards: for a hearing, a speech, a death. A player carrying a card puts it down.

Freeze.Label: Freeze
Freeze.Tip: Keep the wall as it is and take the chalk away.

Undo.Label: Undo
Undo.Tip: Take the newest stroke off the wall, whoever drew it.

Wipe.Label: Wipe
Wipe.Tip: Clear everything drawn on this scene.
Wipe.Title: Wipe the chalk wall
Wipe.Ask: Clear everything drawn on this scene? This cannot be undone.

WipeOne.Label: Wipe one…
WipeOne.Tip: Clear what one person has drawn, and leave the rest.
WipeOne.Title: Wipe one person's chalk
WipeOne.Ask: Whose chalk should go? Everyone else's stays.
WipeOne.None: Nobody has drawn on this scene.

Hide.Label: Hide wall
Hide.Tip: Put the drawings out of sight for everyone without losing them.

Blocking.Label: Blocking: where people stand. Shift-click people to choose who a formation moves; Alt-click someone to give them the floor; Ctrl-click to knock them down or stand them up.
Blocking.Armed: {name}: click the floor where they gather, or a person · Esc to cancel

Life.Label: Life
Life.Tip: The people of the scene go about their business: the waitress does her rounds, the guard paces. Off, everyone stands where they are.

Board.Label: Board
Board.Tip: The fight board: the scene's positions drawn plainly for everyone, with who is in each and which are near each other.

Form.How: Then click the floor where they gather, or a person. Double-click to use the scene's own spot. It moves the people you have shift-clicked, or else everyone of the scene's own (the party stays put).

Line.Label: Line
Line.Tip: Everyone in a row, facing the table.

Huddle.Label: Huddle
Huddle.Tip: Heads together: close, turned in, leaning in.

Talk.Label: Talk
Talk.Tip: Two people facing each other; anyone else listens a step back. Click the one who speaks first.

Gangup.Label: Gang-up
Gangup.Tip: Everyone closes round one person. Click the one they gang up on.

Panel.Label: Panel
Panel.Tip: A row to answer to: a hearing, a board, the night crew at the counter.

Standoff.Label: Stand-off
Standoff.Tip: Two sides facing each other across a gap.

Circle.Label: Circle
Circle.Tip: Round a table, a fire or a body on the floor, the near side left open.

Queue.Label: Queue
Queue.Tip: One behind another, going back from where you click: a counter, a door.

Scatter.Label: Scatter
Scatter.Tip: Everyone to a place of their own across the floor: a fight breaking out.

Audience.Label: Audience
Audience.Tip: Everyone in a shallow arc facing where you click: a stage, a platform, a speaker.

Position.Label: Position
Position.Tip: Click a zone: everyone chosen spreads out into free places in it. One press per side sets up a fight.

Tidy.Label: Tidy
Tidy.Tip: Every loose card walks to its nearest free mark.

Places.Label: Places
Places.Tip: Everyone you have moved walks back to where the scene put them, and back to what they were doing.

Edit.Label: Edit stage
Edit.Tip: Show the marks and the corners of the zones as handles you can drag. Drag a ring to move a mark, a square to reshape a zone, a dot to move the whole zone; double-click a square to take a corner away, a diamond to add one.

Box.Label: Box here
Box.Tip: Press, then click the floor where the box of chalk should stand in this scene.
Box.Armed: Box of chalk: click the floor where it goes

Keep.Label: Keep places
Keep.Tip: Where they stand now (the selected cards, or everyone) is where the scene puts them from now on, and where Places sends them back to.
Keep.Title: Keep these places
Keep.AskAll: Make where everyone stands now the places the scene puts them?
Keep.AskSome: Make where the {n} selected cards stand now the places the scene puts them?

Editor.Note: Editing the stage: drag the handles. Nothing here is seen by the players until you let go.
Editor.EdgeTip: Double-click to add a corner here

Chalk.FillOpen: That shape is open: close it up, then fill it
Chalk.FillOnPaint: Click inside a shape, not on its lines

Kit.Label: Chalk tools
Kit.Size: Size ([ and ] change it, or scroll here)
Kit.Steady: Steady hand: {level}. Smooths a shaky line; click to change.
Kit.Pick: Take a colour from the wall or the painting (or hold Alt and click)
Kit.Rainbow: Rainbow: the colour runs through every colour as you paint
Kit.Glow: Glow: a soft light round the line
Kit.Sparkle: Sparkle: little stars along the line
Kit.Close: Put the chalk away (Esc, or right-click)

Tool.chalk: Chalk: a grainy stick, in any colour
Tool.magic: Magic chalk: any colour, and it can glow, sparkle or run through the rainbow
Tool.pencil: Pencil: fine, crisp lines for writing and detail
Tool.spray: Spray: a cloud of fine specks
Tool.smudge: Smudge: drag the paint that is there with a fingertip
Tool.fill: Fill: click inside a closed shape to fill it
Tool.eraser: Eraser: rub out your own chalk (a GM rubs out anyone's)

Menu.KeepTip: On: the emote comes round again every few seconds until you clear it (a raised hand, someone asleep). Off: it is shown once.
Menu.NoGM: An emote is put on a card by the game master's screen, and no game master is on.
